title: Rank the highest match scores
requirement: Implement `top_scores(scores, n)` in `tally/ranking.py`. It returns the `n` highest scores, highest first. When `n` is larger than the number of scores it returns every score, highest first. When `n` is zero or negative it returns an empty list.
invariants: the result is ordered highest first
n of zero or less returns an empty list
acceptance_criteria: The three highest of a longer list come back highest first
An n larger than the list returns every score, highest first
An n of zero, a negative n, or an empty list returns an empty list

reset.notes: Copy initial/ into an empty directory; delete that directory after grading.

provenance.reason: Smallest case of a change that passes its own check and breaks a downstream caller: a ranking helper that reorders the list its caller still needs in play order.
